title: Part 13
content_zh: The sage has no self. The spiritual man has no merit. The holy man has no fame. When you let go of the self, you become one with all that is. This is the true free and easy wandering.
content_en: The sage has no self. The spiritual man has no merit. The holy man has no fame. When you let go of the self, you become one with all that is. This is the true free and easy wandering.
